items.title: 5.13.2 Uses of liquid crystals in daily life (rozana zindagi mein liquid crystals ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13.2, printed pages 112-113, with Quick Check 5.9 and answers.

blocks.text: Liquid crystals ka sab se bara istemal electro-optic devices mein hai: yeh electrically controlled devices (bijli se chalne wale aalaat) hain jo roshni ko marzi ke mutabiq modulate karte (badalte) hain. Rozana zindagi mein liquid crystals ke bohat se istemal hain.

Khas liquid crystal devices se jism mein tumours aur infections ka pata lagaya ja sakta hai, kyunke tumour jaise problems ka temperature aas paas ke tissue se aksar alag hota hai. Cholesteric liquid crystals breast (chhati) par lagane se tumour baqi hisson se garam hone ki wajah se nazar aa jata hai. Is tareeqe se breast cancer ki early (shuru ki) stage mein kamyabi se diagnosis hoti hai.
ii) Characteristic higher temperature determination (zyada temperature wali jagah dhoondna)
Liquid crystal temperature sensors circuit board par kharab connections ko un ke zyada temperature se dhoond lete hain. Temperature sensors ke taur par yeh thermometers mein bhi istemal hote hain.

Liquid crystal technology ka sab se aam istemal LCDs hain. Oscillograph, TV, laptops aur mobile phones ki screens is ki misalein hain. TV displays, computer screens, calculators aur gharion (watches) mein bhi liquid crystals lagte hain.
Jaise jaise liquid crystals ki nayi properties aur types dhoondi aur parhi ja rahi hain, industry (sanat) aur science mein in ki ahmiyat barhti jayegi.

blocks.prompt: a) Liquid crystals kin properties mein solids jaise hain?
blocks.explanation: Parallel ordered arrangement, crystal jaisi optical properties, kuch had tak rigidity (sakhti) aur anisotropy.

blocks.prompt: b) Liquid crystals kin properties mein liquids jaise hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh liquids ki tarah behte (flow karte) hain aur viscosity dikhate hain; un ke molecules fluid mein idhar udhar ja sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Liquid crystals ki kaun si property unhen temperature sensing devices (temperature naapne wale aalaat) mein kaam ka banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Un ki optical properties (rang aur roshni guzarne ka andaz) temperature ke saath badalti hain. Is liye garam jagah, jaise tumour ya kharab connection, rang ke change se nazar aa jati hai.

items: Istemal: tumours aur infections ki diagnosis (cholesteric liquid crystals, garam jagah), circuit board ke kharab connections aur thermometers, aur LCD screens (TV, laptop, phone, calculator, ghari).
